summary: New MCP clients find Microsoft's sign-in by themselves, and stop and update never stops a run it could not read.

new.title: New MCP clients find Microsoft's sign-in themselves
new.text: The MCP server tells an MCP client where to sign in with Microsoft and what to ask for, so a new client connects without extra setup. You sign in as yourself and see only what your SecurityInsight role allows.

fixes.title: A run is never stopped blind
fixes.text: When the run's record cannot be read, nothing is stopped or started, and it says how to go on.
